# GigAI Tools

> GigAI Tools is an open-source collection of 273 free file and developer tools that run in your browser: PDF, image, video, audio, QR, SVG, SEO and developer utilities. Most tools process your files on your own device, so nothing is uploaded. The few that need a server say so on the page and delete what they receive. It is the code behind https://gigai.tools.

Key facts:
- Live site: https://gigai.tools
- Source: https://github.com/cbsshekhawat18-lab/gigai-tools
- Documentation: https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/
- License: Apache-2.0; backend/app/pdf_repair/ is AGPL-3.0 (optional, off by default). The GigAI name and logo are trademarks.
- Stack: Next.js 15 static export, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4; engines pdf.js, pdf-lib, ffmpeg.wasm, Transformers.js, tesseract.js, svgo; FastAPI backend on Python 3.12+; developer API on PostgreSQL with a Node task worker.
- Of 273 tools, 241 run only in the browser, 29 can read a URL through a fetch proxy, and 3 use the backend for one part.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/quickstart/): clone, npm install, npm run dev; add the FastAPI backend in a second terminal.
- [All tools](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/tools/): every tool by category, with what it does, its formats and where it runs.
- [What runs where](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/privacy-model/): which tools use a server, and what the server keeps.

## Run each part

- [The website](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/guides/website/): develop, build and host the static export.
- [The backend](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/guides/backend/): FastAPI endpoints, settings and tests.
- [The developer API](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/guides/developer-api/): accounts, API keys, jobs and webhooks on PostgreSQL.
- [The task worker](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/guides/worker/): runs developer API jobs.
- [The fetch proxies](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/guides/fetch-proxies/): how URL-reading tools fetch a page.
- [PDF repair](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/guides/pdf-repair/): the optional AGPL OCR module.
- [API clients](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/guides/clients/): npm gigai-tools, PyPI gigai-tools, npm gigai-tools-mcp.
- [Self-hosting](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/self-hosting/): static hosting, systemd, nginx and Docker.
- [Configuration](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/configuration/): every setting.

## Build on it

- [Architecture](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/architecture/): the registry, pages, engines and backend.
- [Adding a tool](https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/gigai-tools/adding-a-tool/): the files a new tool needs.
